jobs.name: a1-reframe-poster
jobs.prompt:
Direct-response Meta feed ad (portrait) for a LIVE PTE exam masterclass, designed to make study-abroad students register. Use the man in the reference image EXACTLY — same face, beard, glasses-free warm confident smile, navy bandhgala jacket — but CUT HIM OUT from his original party background and place him on the RIGHT side, cropped from mid-chest up, facing the viewer. Do not change his face.

Background: warm cream (#F9F7F3). Design system: deep teal (#0E4852) for headline ink, gold (#FBBD29) accents, clean modern geometric sans-serif, lots of whitespace, premium and trustworthy — not busy. Subtle faint gold concentric-ring motif behind him.

LEFT side, stacked top to bottom:
- small gold pill badge with deep-teal text: '4-HOUR LIVE MASTERCLASS'
- huge bold headline, three lines: 'It's not your' / 'English.' / then 'It's the format.' with the word 'format.' in gold.
- one line of medium grey subtext: 'Why fluent speakers still score 65 — and how to fix it in 4 hours.'
- a small strikethrough '₹2,999' then a gold rounded button with deep-teal text: 'Claim my seat  →  ₹589'
- a slim trust row: five small gold stars then deep-teal text '4.9 · 491 Google reviews'

TOP-LEFT corner: a small wordmark 'VERBIS EDU'. BOTTOM: a slim deep-teal band with gold text 'Sat 11 July · 10 AM-2 PM IST · Online'.

Every piece of text must be crisp, correctly spelled and legible. Professional ad-agency quality.

jobs.name: b3-scorecard-65-83
jobs.prompt:
Direct-response Meta feed ad (portrait) built AROUND the attached real PTE Academic score report. Keep the score report EXACTLY as-is — do NOT change, redraw, blur or move any number, and keep the black redaction boxes exactly. Shrink it slightly and place it centered on a warm cream (#F9F7F3) background with a thin gold (#FBBD29) border and a soft shadow, like a real screenshot pinned to the ad.

ABOVE the card: a bold headline in deep teal (#0E4852), two lines: 'She scored 65 in Reading.' then 'Still walked out with 83.' — render the numbers '65' and '83' in gold.
Add two neat gold arrows that stay OUTSIDE the card in the cream margin (never covering any number): one pointing toward the 'Reading 65' circle, one pointing toward the 'Overall Score 83' badge.

BELOW the card: one line of deep-teal text 'PTE doesn't reward perfect English. It rewards knowing how it's scored.' then a small strikethrough '₹2,999' and a gold rounded button with deep-teal text 'Learn the system  →  ₹589'.
At the very bottom: a slim trust row — five small gold stars then '4.9 · 491 Google reviews'. Top-left corner: a small 'VERBIS EDU' wordmark.

Design system: warm cream background, deep teal, gold accents, clean geometric sans-serif, premium and trustworthy. All ADDED text crisp and correctly spelled.
